title: OpenAI sweetens private equity pitch amid enterprise turf war with Anthropic - The Hindu
summary: OpenAI is offering private-equity firms a more attractive deal than Anthropic for joint ventures to raise capital and accelerate AI adoption. OpenAI's deal includes preferred equity stakes with a guaranteed minimum return and early access to AI models.
sentiment_reason: The article presents a positive sentiment as it highlights OpenAI's competitive advantage in attracting private-equity firms with better financial incentives and product offerings compared to its competitor, Anthropic.
